title: at the party f2 and f8 need ctrl held, so a guest cannot freeze a raid by accident
why: The coordinator: at the party the guest plays on keyboard and mouse at localhost, so the F2 (edit the words) and F8 (snip) keys are live, and the F keys sit right above the gun number keys. A stray F2 or F8 froze the raid in a state the guest cannot read. In party mode (the ?party=1 launch, which includes the 2 player arcade demo played from it) a plain F2 or F8 now does nothing and Ctrl+F2 and Ctrl+F8 do the job, the same hidden operator pattern as the Ctrl+Shift+F10 operator card. The chord gives back the one crouch change the Ctrl press makes, as Ctrl with the wheel already does. The tag reads edit words: on (ctrl f2); the Keys window row and the Settings hint name the key that works. Outside party mode nothing changes.
now: At the party, F2 and F8 now need Ctrl held, so a stray press from a guest does nothing. Ctrl and F2 edits the words, Ctrl and F8 snips.
